From Susan B. Anthony who pushed the 90th Amendment to give us the right to vote, to those who helped bring the 19th Amendment, which was, by the way, a Republican, Congress that approved it, and the majority of the Republican states that ratified it, to Richard Nixon who signed the Title IX to eliminate discrimination for women and girls in athletics and education program. I was very proud this week because President Trump, at his Women's History Month celebration, supported my legislation, supports building the museum on the National Mall. And this is a huge development because this will be part of his legacy and the work that he is doing to support women. As you know, he issued his executive order to protect women in sports. to make sure that men could not compete against girls, because we've seen young women, young girls get hurt, his support for IVF in trying to expand access to it, making our cities and our streets safe. These are all really important issues for women, and I'm really glad that we're going to move forward together with President Trump to find the home on the National Mall, which we already know the land that we want to use, and we've got to transfer that land over so we can get this built.
